context: Friends dream up their next trip
purpose: Brainstorm a trip; teach アフリカ/欧米/香港/神戸/広島/わが国/直前/殆ど

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 次は遠くに行きたい。アフリカとか。
lines.en: Next I want to go far — Africa, maybe.
lines.style: adventurous friend floating an idea, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいね、欧米とは全然違う景色だろうね。
lines.en: Nice — totally different scenery from Europe/America.
lines.style: engaged friend agreeing, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私はアジアがいいな。香港の夜景見たい。
lines.en: I prefer Asia. I want to see Hong Kong’s night view.
lines.style: eager friend pitching, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 国内なら、神戸も魅力的だよ。
lines.style: friend suggesting, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 広島の平和記念公園にも行きたい。
lines.en: I want to visit Hiroshima’s peace park too.
lines.style: thoughtful friend adding, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わが国にも、まだまだ訪れたい場所があるね。
lines.en: There are still places in our country I want to visit.
lines.style: reflective friend embracing home, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 直前まで予定が決まらないけど。
lines.en: Plans aren’t set until just before departure, though.
lines.style: wry friend admitting, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 殆ど決めてないけど、それも楽しい。
lines.en: Almost nothing’s decided, but that’s fun too.
lines.style: easygoing friend enjoying spontaneity, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
